infoSpacedStagesDesc: Visual progression showing where your cards are in the memory lifecycle: New -> Learning -> Mastered.
infoSpacedStagesHow: Daily consistency moves blue (New) cards into purple (Learning), and eventually into green (Mastered).
infoDeckMasteryDesc: Tracks your spaced repetition journey from fresh new cards to mature retained memories.
infoDeckMasteryHow: Practice weak cards regularly and review scheduled cards daily to reach 100% mastery.
infoOverallProgressDesc: Percentage of all deck cards that have been introduced into your study cycle.
infoOverallProgressHow: Start a study session to introduce remaining 'New / Unseen' cards into your review queue.
infoLearnedCardsDesc: Cards that you have studied at least once and are currently being tracked by the spaced repetition system.
infoLearnedCardsHow: Flip through unstudied flashcards in a learning session to count them as learned.
infoReviewDueDesc: Cards whose scheduled spaced interval has arrived and are ready for testing today.
infoReviewDueHow: Review these cards today! Promptly reviewing due cards prevents memory decay.
infoMasteredCardsDesc: Cards remembered accurately across multiple long intervals with a high ease factor.
infoMasteredCardsHow: Keep grading cards 'Easy' or 'Good' over weeks. Consecutive successful reviews graduate cards to Mastered!
infoNewUnseenDesc: Cards in the deck that you haven't opened or practiced yet.
infoNewUnseenHow: Click 'Start Learning' to begin introducing these cards.
infoLearningReviewingDesc: Active cards undergoing the spaced repetition cycle to prevent forgetting.
infoLearningReviewingHow: Review these cards when due to strengthen neural pathways.
infoMasteredRetainedDesc: Cards locked into long-term memory that need very infrequent review.
infoMasteredRetainedHow: Consistently rate cards 'Easy' or 'Good' across spaced sessions to turn them into Mastered!
infoAccuracyDesc: Your overall rate of correct answers combining flashcard recall ease and practice quiz answers.
infoAccuracyHow: Aim for 85%+ by reviewing cards on time and choosing 'Easy' or 'Good' when words come naturally.
infoTotalTimeDesc: Estimated time spent flipping flashcards plus recorded time in multiple-choice quizzes.
infoTotalTimeHow: Do a quick 3-5 minute session every day to steadily build up your study duration.
infoTotalReviewsDesc: Every card repetition rated in flashcard sessions plus questions solved in quizzes.
infoTotalReviewsHow: Keep your 'Review Due' queue at 0 every day to continuously grow your total reviews.
infoMasteryRateDesc: The proportion of cards that have graduated into the mature long-term memory stage.
infoMasteryRateHow: Answer cards correctly across several spaced intervals (7+ days). Consistent reviews turn cards into Mastered!
infoQuizDrillsDesc: Multiple-choice speed drills that test your quick recognition under a countdown timer.
infoQuizDrillsHow: Click 'Take Quiz' to run drills. Aim for 100% accuracy and faster answer speeds.
infoQuizzesCompletedDesc: Total practice quiz drills finished for this deck.
infoQuizzesCompletedHow: Play a quiz after reviewing flashcards to test your recognition under pressure.
infoQuizAccuracyDesc: Ratio of correct choices out of all quiz questions attempted.
infoQuizAccuracyHow: Take your time to read the options carefully before the countdown bar advances.
infoBestScoreDesc: Your highest recorded accuracy in a single quiz drill session.
infoBestScoreHow: Get all questions right in a drill session to reach a 100% Best Score badge!
infoQuizTimeDesc: Cumulative active time spent answering practice quiz questions.
infoQuizTimeHow: Keep practicing to improve both your speed and accuracy simultaneously.
infoRecallGradeDesc: Distribution of difficulty ratings chosen for cards reviewed under the SM-2 Spaced Repetition system.
infoRecallGradeHow: Honest grading produces the best intervals: rate Easy when instant, Good when confident, Hard when struggling, and Again when forgotten.
infoEasyGradeDesc: Word was recalled effortlessly without thinking. Ease factor rises (>= 2.5) and interval extends significantly.
infoEasyGradeHow: Mark Easy when a word has entered your active vocabulary and requires no mental pause.
infoGoodGradeDesc: Word was recalled accurately with standard effort. Follows regular SM-2 schedule (1d -> 3d -> 6d).
infoGoodGradeHow: Mark Good when you knew the answer correctly but took a moment to think.
infoHardGradeDesc: Recalled with significant difficulty or guessing. Ease factor drops and the card reviews sooner.
infoHardGradeHow: Click 'Practice Weak Cards' or study example sentences when cards are in Hard.
infoAgainGradeDesc: Could not remember the card or gave the wrong meaning. Interval resets to 1 day.
infoAgainGradeHow: Don't worry about failures! The SM-2 system re-queues them immediately so you can master them quickly.
infoDeckAnalyticsDesc: Aggregated memory metrics, recall quality scores, and speed drill outcomes for this collection.
infoDeckAnalyticsHow: Complete daily flashcard reviews and speed quizzes to expand and strengthen your analytics.
